title: fix(rest)!: an anonymous public-form submission carries no file
body:
Fixes #25622
Fixes #25572

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## What this changes

Ruling C on #25572 (the maintainer, verbatim: 「25619 C 25495 B」; the ruling record is on PR #25619): **an anonymous public-form submission carries no file.**

- **The submit door** (`@objectstack/rest`). `POST /forms/:slug/submit` refuses a value in a field whose declared type is a file type (`FILE_REFERENCE_TYPES`: `file`, `image`, `avatar`, `video`, `audio`). It names the field and refuses before anything is written. The answer is the door's existing envelope, `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`, with one `fields[]` entry per file field: the ADR-0114 field code `invalid_value` and the field's label. If the same submission also leaves a `required` field empty, both are reported in one envelope. An empty or absent file field submits as before. Only the fields the form declares are judged, so the refusal names nothing that `GET /forms/:slug` does not already publish. No error code is added.
- **The file-reference claim path** (`@objectstack/service-storage`) now looks a referenced file up within the organization the write acts in. It uses the channel that already stamps a copied file for that organization, so the driver's tenant scope for the posture in force decides what the lookup sees. A referenced file id outside that scope is kept as written and is neither claimed nor copied, exactly as an id the platform does not manage. The module writes no organization comparison of its own. A write that carries no organization, and the `single` posture, look files up as before.

Not in this PR: the publish-time refusal of a guest-facing form that declares a file field (#25650, `domain:spec`), and any guest upload door (ruled out by C).

## Declarations

- `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`. The door refuses a request shape it accepted, and the claim path reaches fewer files. Nothing is widened. Both claims carry `Clause-②: no` with no arm; the dispatch asked for the arm to be judged, and AGENTS.md's Post-Task Checklist step 3 names `(narrowing)` for this case, so the arm is added.
- `Metadata-protocol: none`. Nothing a metadata author writes changes.
- One `patch` changeset on both packages, `fix(rest)!:`, with the BREAKING section, the migration line and the ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. `check-adr-0087-registration` reads it as `[BREAKING+bang+clause-②-narrowing]` and passes.

## Composition with #25641

#25641 (`domain:spec`, ADR-0138 D5) also edits `packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts`, in `resolveFormBySlug`, the submit door's context literal and the imports. This PR's edit sits in the submit door's `required` judgement, below both hunks, with unchanged lines between them. A local `git merge-tree --write-tree` of this branch with #25641's head `08b020c9d3` exits 0 with no conflicted path (`form-routes.ts` is not a merge-driver path, so the local answer is GitHub's). Whichever PR lands second merges `main`.

## One existing pin changed, with its subject kept

`public-form-intake-availability.test.ts`, "single posture, walled object — accepted, and the object is not even read for the predicate", asserted that the whole submit read only `view` metadata. The submit now reads the object's declarations once whenever a declared field carries a value, as the `required` judgement already did for forms with required entries. The pin now asserts `['view', 'object']`: exactly one object read, by the field judgement. A predicate that read the object on this posture would be a second read and would still turn it red.

## Tests

All on head `80aab79ea2`, each package's exit code captured separately:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest test`: Test Files 321 passed (321), Tests 6417 passed, 326 skipped. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest typecheck`: exit 0. The test-layer program (`tsconfig.test.json`, counted with `--listFiles`) compiles both test files this PR touches.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-storage test`: Test Files 63 passed (63), Tests 1137 passed. `typecheck`: exit 0, and the new test file is in its test-layer program.
- New suites: `packages/rest/src/public-form-file-field.test.ts` has 11 tests: the refusal by value shape (a file id, an external URL, an inline file value), a multi-valued field, two fields at once, one envelope with `required`, four empty/absent controls and the undeclared-field boundary. `packages/services/service-storage/src/file-reference-organization-scope.test.ts` has 6 tests on a real `ObjectQL` and `SqlDriver` under the `isolated` posture with the hooks installed as the plugin installs them: insert and update in one organization, two controls in the writing organization (claim, and a copy stamped for it), and the `single` posture. The refusal pins assert `code` and `status` (`VALIDATION_FAILED`, `400`) plus each entry's field, code and label. Message wording is not pinned; each message is only required to name its label.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` with the root config over `packages/rest/src` and `packages/services/service-storage/src`: exit 0.
- Full dogfood battery (owed for the `(narrowing)` arm), `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the shared lock with no shard and no path: it was running when this PR opened, and its counts are in the `os-dev-report` comment on #25622.

## Proof

Each leg mutated through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which verifies on disk that the anchor hit, the blob changed and the restore matched the HEAD blob. Both subjects resolve through relative `src` imports in their suites, so no `dist/` is involved.

- **The door.** With the file-type judgement replaced by `continue`, the 6 refusal pins of `public-form-file-field.test.ts` redden (the door answers `201`), and its 5 control and boundary pins hold. Restored: the blob `e6855e87be17` equals HEAD's and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **The claim path, the lookup before the write.** With this change's context for that lookup undone, exactly 1 of the 6 organization-scope pins reddens (the copy pin). Restored: the blob equals HEAD's.
- **The claim path, the claim's own lookup.** With this change's context undone there, exactly 2 of the 6 redden (the insert and update claim pins). Restored: the blob equals HEAD's.
- The two controls and the `single`-posture pin held in every leg.

- Derived on `80aab79ea2` by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths; the change set comes from the merge base): 73 commands, each exit code captured before any pipe. 72 exited 0 in sequence. `pnpm check:type-check-debt` first exited 3 (its own closure build never got a turn on the shared verify lock, so nothing was measured), and its rerun under the lock exited 0 with no entry above its recorded number. `--ran`: 73 derived, 73 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, exit 0. `check-adr-0087-registration` reads the changeset as `[BREAKING+bang+clause-②-narrowing]` with an accepted disposition, and `check-changeset-no-major` reports no major bump.
- `pnpm lint` (the root `eslint . --no-inline-config`) is CI's run. Locally it was run over the two touched packages only (above).
- The tree note the derivation prints: `80aab79ea2` merged `origin/main` at `9dac9eb8d6`. Since then `main` has gained refactor moves in `objectql`, `driver-sql` and `metadata-protocol` and the template pins, and one derivation input (`scripts/sync-template-versions.mjs`) changed upstream. The derived list did not change between the two merges. CI reads the PR's merge ref.
- CI check-runs had not concluded when this PR opened; convergence is read by the seat.

## Acceptance notes

- `GET /forms/:slug` still serves a declared file field in the form's sections, so a renderer may show an upload control that a visitor cannot use. That belongs to the publish half (#25650), which refuses such a form at publish. It is not changed here.
- The refusal message is inline English beside the `required` message, which the door renders from the built-in catalog without a locale. No catalog key is added.
